title: Legend
identity: George Enescu’s Légende (1906) was composed for trumpet and piano as a Paris Conservatoire competition work. The cataloged soprano-saxophone item appears to be a transcription, but its arranger, edition, and saxophone part were not verified.

evidence.claim: George Enescu National Museum states that Enescu composed Légende for trumpet and piano as a 1906 Paris Conservatoire competition piece and shows the Enoch score cover.
IMSLP lists the 1906 work as trumpet and piano and provides trumpet score/part scans; it does not list a saxophone edition.

collection_flag: Original work for trumpet and piano; the saxophone version’s arrangement status, edition and intended audience require confirmation.

score_links.description: Score/catalogue lead; notation not visually inspected.

gaps: No saxophone edition or notation was verified; trumpet range/technique cannot be transferred to saxophone.
No saxophone performance recording or pedagogical placement verified.
